title: We make games we love.

title: Insult GoatBro Team
text: About the studio Insult GoatBro Team vIgnitio founded our team on April 30, 2017. Our first project was an Undertale fan game called Facing Demons. Since then, we’ve explored new genres and formats, from puzzle games to visual novels. We’ve been travelling to events together for three years. We placed third at the 2024 Underparty Gamejam in Moscow, 17th at Kapella Jam 3 in 2026, and 22nd at Anivisual Jam 4 in 2022. Find us online
